name: OMDB-GAP1 models: COD band-gap prediction release
description: SOAP/kernel-ridge and SchNet band-gap predictions for a large COD-derived organic-crystal screening set, distinct from the DFT-labelled OMDB-GAP1 training corpus.
version: COD predictions v1.1 on the OMDB dataset page; 2019 paper cohort
count_display: 260,092 COD crystal entries with model-predicted band gaps
count_scope: Named v1.1 COD prediction download, corresponding to the paper cohort of organic structures with at most 500 atoms per unit cell

sources.title: OMDB official dataset downloads
sources.evidence: Separately lists OMDB-GAP1 v1.1 at 12,500 materials and a COD v1.1 machine-learning prediction download at 260,092 materials.

sources.title: Band Gap Prediction for Large Organic Crystal Structures with Machine Learning
sources.evidence: Section 3.2 describes selecting organic COD structures containing C/H and supported elements, limiting cells to 500 atoms, and computing 260,092 model predictions; Data Availability identifies the release.

sources.title: OMDB COD prediction download access check
sources.evidence: Public download link redirects to the login page, which offers free registration; payload was not obtained without an account.

caveats: Properties are machine-learning predictions, not 260,092 new DFT calculations or measured band gaps.
The source crystal structures are COD-derived and overlap the COD family; no independent new-structure total is implied.
Provider release count was not independently recounted because download currently requires login.
Structure-linked classification denotes the named COD-source linkage; atomic-coordinate content and exact payload columns were not inspected.
Dataset-specific reuse license was not identified in the inspected download and terms pages.
